heading: Model-dependent loss of a single persistent polarity pattern.
supporting_panels: Full S2 regime/coverage maps, S7 fixed-mean sigma sweeps, S9 optical fingerprints and S0 H3 component/pair tables; the all-model main overview can lead this framing.
weaknesses: Only the multiple-region class is qualified and corroborated across the eligible models. Goryachev contrast loss is forced/undercovered, and no distinct eligible pair passes the full fingerprint test. A descriptive difference cannot be promoted to a confirmed mechanism-specific failure law.
further_runs: Sample additional fixed-mean Goryachev transition inputs with mean controls and sigma contrasts to seek an abnormal state with adequate heading coverage, then predeclare and retest the distinct-class fingerprints. Longer weak-input runs would also tighten the currently overlapping noise-tolerance bounds.
